project_summary.description: AI-driven semantic segmentation and matte extractor for VFX rotoscoping
project_summary.architecture: SAM2 + Depth Anything V2 + ViTMatte pipeline
project_summary.primary_goal: Extract high-fidelity alpha mattes with hair detail preservation

core_modules.vitmatte_refine.py: ViTMatte integration with SOURCEOFTRUTH scientific trimap

architectural_decisions.rationale: SOURCEOFTRUTH Golden Rule: erode 10px for core FG, dilate 25px for wide search area, everything between = Unknown (128)
Use Z-Score not absolute thresholds. Core: >0.8, BG: <0.2, Matting Zone: 0.4-0.6
Process in 32-bit float linear space (Gamma 1.0) to see sub-pixel differences in dark hair
Unknown region must be 25-40px wide for ViTMatte transformer attention mechanism
Post-process alpha with Guided Filter (radius 4, eps 1e-6) to align with RGB edges

changes: Implemented SOURCEOFTRUTH scientific trimap mode in vitmatte_refine.py
Added srgb_to_linear() and linear_to_srgb() color space utilities
Added depth confidence intervals (0.4-0.6 as Unknown zone)
Cleaned up repository: removed 12 debug scripts and 830MB of test outputs
